extraction_evaluation.matching: strict typed identifiers; Unicode NFKC and whitespace only; values/units preserved; no fuzzy/LLM matching
extraction_evaluation.predicted_duplicate_policy: extra predictions count as false positives
extraction_evaluation.macro_policy: exclude absent-in-both types; explicitly report undefined denominators

qa.primary_quality_metric: independent source-supported answer correctness; rubric frozen before labeling
qa.paired_tests: question-level paired sign flip; Wilcoxon supplementary when available; Holm across reported sign-flip comparisons
qa.failure_policy: report failures and coverage for every method; quality failure=0 in end-to-end utility; conditional paired results disclosed separately; missing repeat grids block confirmatory reporting

leakage_policy: No tuning on the 40-paper holdout or 45 QA test questions; the QA set is legacy project-internal, not an unseen external benchmark
limits: Model semantic accuracy, human independence, benchmark completion and SOTA support are not established by this protocol file.

source_quality_policy.quote_boundary: contiguous clean fragments; no quote across removed lines
source_quality_policy.limits: not OCR or mathematical recovery; semantic review remains necessary
